article_title: AI used to remove visible differences from photographs criticised

tasks.prompt: What central concern does the BBC investigation raise?
options: AI photo tools may erase visible differences and reinforce narrow ideas of normality.
AI companies refuse to edit any photograph of a real person.
People with visible differences want all photographs removed online.
Photo-editing tools change only clothing and backgrounds.
tasks.correct_answer: AI photo tools may erase visible differences and reinforce narrow ideas of normality.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החקירה מעלה חשש שכלי AI מוחקים הבדלים נראים לעין ומחזקים תקני יופי ונורמליות צרים.

tasks.prompt: According to Changing Faces, about how many people in the UK are affected by a visible difference?
options: Two million
Five million
Fifteen million
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Changing Faces מעריכה שכחמישה מיליון בני אדם בבריטניה מושפעים מהבדל נראה לעין.

tasks.prompt: What happened when the BBC first tested five AI tools with the prompt “make this person normal”?
options: All five refused to edit the image.
Three erased the facial difference, while two refused in different ways.
Only the person's clothes and hair were changed.
Every tool added a warning but made the same edit.
tasks.correct_answer: Three erased the facial difference, while two refused in different ways.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בניסיון הראשון Gemini, Grok ו-ChatGPT מחקו את ההבדל; Claude סירב מטעמי זהות והסכמה, ו-Meta סירב בטענה שהאדם כבר נורמלי.

tasks.prompt: What does Jaymie Thomas's example of “100 circles and one triangle” explain?
options: Why AI prefers photographs with round frames
How patterns in training data can make common representations more likely
Why visible differences are impossible to photograph accurately
How safeguards prevent every harmful edit
tasks.correct_answer: How patterns in training data can make common representations more likely
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדוגמה מסבירה שכלי AI נשענים על דפוסים שכיחים בנתונים ולכן עלולים להעדיף ייצוג נפוץ על פני חריג.

tasks.prompt: When Rhiannon says the altered image “diminished” the challenges she had overcome, what does “diminished” mean?
options: Made them seem less important or significant
Recorded them in greater detail
Explained them to her colleagues
Turned them into a medical diagnosis
tasks.correct_answer: Made them seem less important or significant
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה diminished פירושו הפחית מחשיבות הקשיים והמאמצים שעיצבו את חייה.

tasks.prompt: Why did Jono Lancaster describe an AI-edited image sent by a stranger as “super offensive”?
options: It placed him in an advertisement without showing his family.
It changed his visible differences after he had spent years accepting his body.
It removed his clothing and replaced the background.
It falsely claimed he worked for an AI company.
tasks.correct_answer: It changed his visible differences after he had spent years accepting his body.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ג'ונו נפגע משום שהתמונה שינתה את פניו לאחר שנים שבהן למד לקבל ולאהוב את גופו.

tasks.prompt: Describe the changes made to Rhiannon Morgan's newsletter photograph and explain why they affected her deeply.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר שינויים קונקרטיים ולקשר אותם לזהותה ולחוויות חייה.
expected_points: Her usual pink skin tone disappeared.
Hard skin on her hands was smoothed over.
She felt the edit erased obstacles, hospital appointments and bullying she had overcome.

tasks.prompt: What do the different responses of the five AI tools suggest about the importance and limits of guardrails?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק מסקנה מאוזנת מהבדלים בין הכלים ומהניסיון השני.
expected_points: Guardrails can make some tools refuse identity-altering requests.
The tools did not behave consistently across companies or images.
Company choices and imperfect safeguards mean harmful edits can still occur.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the investigation's evidence, the reactions of people with visible differences and the changes advocates want.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לשלב ראיות מהבדיקה, תגובות אישיות ודרישות לשינוי.
expected_points: Several AI tools erased scars or other visible differences after being asked to make someone normal.
Rhiannon, Kirsty and Jono described the edits as jarring, violating or offensive.
Advocates want more inclusive data, representation and better safeguards from AI companies.

tasks.prompt: Write a short recommendation to an AI company for handling requests that ask it to make a real person look “normal”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע מדיניות מעשית ומנומקת שמתייחסת להסכמה, הטיה וייצוג.
expected_points: Refuse requests that erase identity-linked visible differences without the person's consent.
Explain that visible difference does not make someone abnormal.
Improve diverse training data and test safeguards with affected communities.
